title: Zoom with Annotation Coordinate Sync
description: Implement zoom in/out functionality that scales both PDF pages and annotation strokes proportionally. Annotations must not drift or misalign when zooming.
action: Add zoom controls (Ctrl+MouseWheel, toolbar +/- buttons, zoom percentage display). Apply ScaleTransform to the content container (Grid holding Image+InkCanvas per page). Since InkCanvas is inside the same transformed container, strokes scale automatically. Re-render PDF bitmaps at higher resolution when zoom > 150% to maintain clarity. Zoom range: 50%-400%, step 10%.

criteria: Source contains PreviewMouseWheel handler or Ctrl+Wheel logic
XAML contains zoom percentage display (TextBlock or Label)
convergence.verification: dotnet build && manual test: zoom in/out with Ctrl+Wheel, verify annotations stay aligned
convergence.definition_of_done: User can zoom PDF and annotations together without drift. Ctrl+Wheel zooms, toolbar shows percentage, +/- buttons work.

files.change: Wrap page ItemsControl in a container with LayoutTransform=ScaleTransform bound to ZoomLevel. Add zoom controls to toolbar.
Add ZoomLevel property (double, default 1.0), ZoomInCommand, ZoomOutCommand, ZoomResetCommand. Clamp to 0.5-4.0 range.
Add PreviewMouseWheel handler: if Ctrl held, adjust ZoomLevel by ±0.1

implementation: Add ZoomLevel property to MainViewModel (double, default 1.0, range 0.5-4.0, step 0.1)
In MainWindow.xaml: wrap the ItemsControl in a Grid with LayoutTransform bound to ZoomLevel via ScaleTransform (ScaleX=ScaleY=ZoomLevel)
Add to toolbar: Button '-' (ZoomOut), TextBlock '{ZoomLevel:P0}', Button '+' (ZoomIn), Button 'Reset'
In MainWindow.xaml.cs: handle PreviewMouseWheel — if Ctrl key down, e.Handled=true, adjust ZoomLevel
Optional: re-render PDF pages at higher DPI when ZoomLevel > 1.5 for sharper text (call PdfRenderService.RenderPage with targetWidth * ZoomLevel)

integration: Draw annotation, zoom, verify no drift
success_metrics: Annotations stay aligned at all zoom levels
PDF text remains readable when zoomed

reference.pattern: WPF ScaleTransform on container for unified zoom

rationale.chosen_approach: LayoutTransform on the parent container scales both Image and InkCanvas uniformly, eliminating coordinate drift by design.
decision_factors: Single transform point avoids sync issues
InkCanvas strokes scale with container automatically
rationale.tradeoffs: At high zoom, bitmap PDF may look blurry — mitigated by re-rendering at higher resolution

risks: High zoom + large PDF = memory pressure from high-res bitmaps
